questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a traffic law sign that you must obey. When posted, you cannot make a right turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful before entering the intersection. You do not have to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed limit.
The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
You must not travel below the speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the highest speed allowed on this road under good conditions. You can drive slower based on weather or road conditions, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits left turns. Making a left turn at this location is unsafe and illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the center divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you cannot enter. It is commonly seen on one-way streets or expressway ramps where traffic flows in the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. A speed advisory sign below a curve warning sign tells you the safe speed to take the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians go first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a Yield sign with a triangular shape. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and cross traffic go first. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Slow down to avoid brake damage and prevent accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Reduce your speed to avoid accidents and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that pedestrians may cross ahead. Stop if someone is crossing at the marked crosswalk and wait until they completely cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This low clearance sign shows the height from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this case, it is 12 feet 6 inches.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a side road is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign showing 55 mph is the fastest you can legally drive. In bad weather or poor conditions, drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you the road will curve right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs are only used for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and leave extra space between your vehicle and the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate work zones. When you see orange signs, cones, or barrels, stay alert for unexpected conditions. This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead and you must follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You often see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road direction is changing or the road is becoming narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to immediate hazards. This sign tells you to slow down for a sharp turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic and enforce driving rules. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a traffic lane means you can use that lane.
